title: In Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7, a user who can read splunkd_access.log or the _internal Splunk index…
description: Splunk App for Stream versions below 8.1.7 contain a vulnerability where a user with read access to splunkd_access.log or the _internal Splunk index can recover the Stream forwarder authentication key. This key is exposed because it is sent in an internal request URL that is logged in splunkd_access.log. An attacker with this key could impersonate a trusted Stream forwarder.
